claims.text: A page goes to text recognition only with fewer than 20 selectable characters and at least 30% picture coverage; each page checked on its own
Scanned pages get a page comment marker; text pages and blanks don't; consecutive text pages are joined
Page 2's last line ran into page 4's first line
Page 5 (40-character stamp) returned only the stamp; form missing
Page 6 receipt covering about 19% returned nothing; page 7 text appeared twice; blanks left no trace
Exported as images, page 5 returned stamp and full form, page 6 the receipt with total 6.95
No page in the packet produced a warning
A blank page grouped with no text page is converted alone and adds 'No extractable text found in this document.'; next to text pages it leaves no trace
Warnings exist only for a scanned page that returns no text and for scans past the 100-page limit
Images are limited to 10 MB each and 20 files per batch

not_claimed: how the interface displays page counts or warnings
that every PDF tool adds hidden duplicate text
